description: Use this when the user names a US coastal place and needs the NOAA tide prediction station to use for a tide table. Takes a city or town (US places of about 15,000 people or more), a station name, or a NOAA station id, and returns the nearest stations with distance in miles. Does not return tide times; use generate_tide_calendar for those. Does not cover places outside the NOAA CO-OPS station list.

limit.description: How many stations to return, 1 to 10. Default 5, e.g. 5.

place.description: A US coastal city or town, a NOAA tide station name, or a NOAA station id. Add the state after a comma if you know it, e.g. Monterey, CA or Montauk or 9414290.

state.description: Optional two-letter US state or territory code to narrow the search, e.g. FL.

name: find_tide_stations
title: Find tide stations
